title: Man Flees Traffic Stop and Loses Game of Hide & Seek
description:
In Onalaska, WI, police conducted a traffic stop on a speeding vehicle. After discovering the driver had a warrant, the man suddenly drove off, bailed the vehicle, and hid in the woods from police...
